lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.23 - A Look and learn

details: Look and learn reinforces the target structures, covering meaning form & pronunciation.
Look for correct pronunciation of both the full and contracted forms of the target structure.
“We have some new children in our class today. Can you help me say the school items for them?”

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.23 - B Look and write

details: Look and write strengthens recognition of target words and gives students an opportunity to practise spelling them, with the writing of the words in the appropriate spaces reinforcing language chunk recall.
Look for correct word choice and spelling, consistent letter formation, neat handwriting within the lines, and finger spacing between the words.
“They have a lot of questions! Let’s tell them everything we have in our classroom.”

lessonPlan.topic: Phonics Book Pp.112 - 114 - A Point and say

details: Point and say checks understanding of the target word meaning and sound. Point shows they match what they hear to the right target word in the picture. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for correct pointing at the target words in the pictures, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

lessonPlan.topic: Phonics Book Pp.112 - 114 - C&D Circle words that start with s, h or n. Find the words that start with s, h or n.

details: This activity strengthens the identification of the first sounds of words, reinforces sound/letter recognition, reinforces comprehension of the words by linking them to the pictures, and strengthens awareness of the form with the circling of the words.
Look for correct sound/letter recognition and circling of the words that begin with the specified letters, and correct identification of the pictures of the circled words.
